description.en: Open the Explorer at Dinosauria to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开恐龙，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Dinosauria time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的恐龙时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Dinosauria interval in the diversity view to inspect bundled sample counts, not an estimate of total richness.
description.zh: 在多样性视图中打开有来源边界的恐龙区间，检查包内样本计数，而不是总体丰富度估计。

limitations: Counts are derived from the bundled, bounded occurrence sample and do not estimate total diversity, preservation-corrected richness, or a complete taxon range.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Yinlong time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的隐龙时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Dinosauria interval in the diversity view to inspect bundled sample counts, not an estimate of total richness.
description.zh: 在多样性视图中打开有来源边界的恐龙区间，检查包内样本计数，而不是总体丰富度估计。

limitations: Counts are derived from the bundled, bounded occurrence sample and do not estimate total diversity, preservation-corrected richness, or a complete taxon range.

title.zh: 布氏盗龙坎德拉里亚标本窗口

description.en: Open the map around the source-bounded Buriolestes holotype interval to inspect sampled occurrence context beside the documented ULBRA-PVT280 evidence.
description.zh: 在来源限定的布氏盗龙正模标本时间段附近打开地图，结合已记录的 ULBRA-PVT280 证据检查采样出现背景。

limitations: ULBRA-PVT280 and its Candelária Sequence context in Brazil are the bounded specimen-and-stratum evidence; the rounded 232.3 Ma map age is an interval selector, not a direct date on the individual.

Faunivory and placement near the sauropodomorph root are comparative character-matrix and ancestral-state reconstructions, not observations of ancestry. The bounded, non-random occurrence sample and map markers do not establish a global FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestor, or exact specimen-marker co-location.

title.zh: 曙奔龙下埃利奥特组标本窗口

description.en: Open the map within the source-bounded Lower Elliot Formation interval to inspect sampled context for the Eocursor holotype, SAM-PK-K8025.
description.zh: 在来源限定的下埃利奥特组时间段内打开地图，检查曙奔龙正模标本 SAM-PK-K8025 的采样背景。

limitations: SAM-PK-K8025 is partial material from South Africa's Lower Elliot Formation; 205.7 Ma is a rounded study-level formation window, not a direct specimen date.

Its early-ornithischian position is a morphology-matrix result rather than a preserved ancestor. Sampling and preservation are limited, and the map does not establish a global FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, or exact specimen locality.

title.zh: 腿龙查茅斯泥岩组窗口

description.en: Open the map around the source-bounded Charmouth Mudstone interval to inspect sampled context for the Scelidosaurus lectotype, NHMUK R1111.
description.zh: 在来源限定的查茅斯泥岩组时间段附近打开地图，检查腿龙选模标本 NHMUK R1111 的采样背景。

limitations: NHMUK R1111 and associated osteoderms are locality-and-stratum-bounded to the Charmouth Mudstone Formation in Dorset; 192 Ma is a rounded interval, not a directly measured age for every element.

Armour association is observed where preservation survives, while keratinous covering, biology and stem-ankylosaur placement are comparative reconstructions. Sparse, non-random sampled markers do not demonstrate a global FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, or exact lectotype-map co-location.

title.zh: 羽王龙义县组皮肤衍生物窗口

description.en: Open the map around the source-bounded Yixian Formation interval to inspect sampled context for the three documented Yutyrannus integument-bearing specimens.
description.zh: 在来源限定的义县组时间段附近打开地图，检查三件已记录具皮肤衍生物羽王龙标本的采样背景。

limitations: ZCDM V5000, ZCDM V5001 and ELDM V1001 are a three-specimen sample from the Yixian Formation, Liaoning; the 125 Ma route is a rounded formation interval rather than a direct date for each skeleton.

Associated filamentous integument is the specimen evidence, but insulation, display, whole-body coverage and phylogenetic implications are functional or comparative reconstructions. The bounded, non-random sample cannot establish a global FAD, complete distribution, direct ancestry, or exact specimen-marker co-location.

title.zh: 鼠龙拉古纳科罗拉达生长序列窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 188.5 Ma Laguna Colorada Formation window in Patagonia to inspect the sampled Mussaurus growth series, including the hatchling, yearling PVL 4587 and adult material used in the locomotor models.
description.zh: 打开巴塔哥尼亚拉古纳科罗拉达组约 1.885 亿年前窗口，检查鼠龙取样生长序列，包括用于运动模型的孵化幼体、一龄 PVL 4587 与成年材料。

limitations: The named individuals and Laguna Colorada Formation context are the direct specimen and stratigraphic evidence; 192.9–184.2 Ma is a study-level envelope, not a direct date on each skeleton or a global Mussaurus FAD/LAD.

CT, surface scans and photogrammetry provide model inputs; the forward centre-of-mass shift and bipedal-to-quadrupedal stance are reconstruction results controlled by segmentation, body-volume assumptions and combining individuals, not a preserved gait, ecological observation or evolutionary stage.

PBDB markers and paired modern/palaeocoordinates show bounded sampled context with collection and preservation bias; they do not establish complete distribution, direct ancestry, exact fossil-to-map co-registration or a global range.

title.zh: 巨雷龙埃利奥特组巨型化窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 197.75 Ma Elliot Formation window in South Africa to inspect holotype BP/1/7120 and the evidence used to model early sauropodomorph body mass and quadrupedality.
description.zh: 打开南非埃利奥特组约 1.9775 亿年前窗口，检查正模 BP/1/7120 及用于建模早期蜥脚形类体重和四足性的证据。

limitations: BP/1/7120 is a partial postcranial holotype from the Elliot Formation; 200.5–195 Ma is a formation-level occurrence envelope, not a direct specimen date, global genus FAD/LAD or origin of quadrupedality.

Limb histology and preserved anatomy are observations, whereas the approximately 12-tonne estimate and habitual quadrupedality with flexed, non-columnar limbs are comparative scaling and posture models; neither establishes a direct ancestor or an unobserved ecological behaviour.

The represented South African occurrence and any PBDB coordinate are bounded, non-random sample context subject to preservation and locality uncertainty; the map does not reconstruct complete distribution or exact fossil-to-paleomap co-registration.

title.zh: 三角龙地狱溪组头骨变异窗口

description.en: Open the 68–66 Ma latest Cretaceous window to inspect the northeastern Montana Hell Creek skull sample and its stratigraphically constrained horn and rostrum variation.
description.zh: 打开 6800–6600 万年前晚白垩世窗口，检查美国蒙大拿州东北部地狱溪组头骨样本及受地层约束的角与吻部变异。

limitations: The Hell Creek specimens and associated western North American sample are the source-bounded evidence; 68–66 Ma is a sampled latest-Maastrichtian interval, not complete Triceratops endpoints or a global FAD/LAD.

Nasal-horn, rostrum and postorbital-horn variation and intermediate combinations are cranial and stratigraphic observations; interpreting them as an ontogenetic or evolutionary trend is an analysis, not a direct ancestor–descendant series, and Triceratops–Torosaurus taxonomy remains contested.

The cited studies do not directly determine diet, habitat, locomotion or ecological guild. PBDB coordinates represent bounded collection records, not exact study-skull locations, complete distribution or fossil-to-paleomap co-registration.

title.zh: 窃蛋龙类乌哈托格德巢穴关联窗口

description.en: Use the 75–71 Ma interval as generic taxon/age map context and read the linked evidence for IGM 100/979, a partial oviraptorid skeleton over a circular egg clutch from the Djadokhta Formation at Ukhaa Tolgod. The dossier distinguishes the preserved association from behavioural interpretation.
description.zh: 以 75–71 Ma 区间作为一般类群/时间地图背景，阅读关联证据中的 IGM 100/979：来自乌哈托格德达扎多赫塔组、保存于圆形蛋窝上方的窃蛋龙类部分骨架。档案区分保存的关联关系与行为解释。

limitations: IGM 100/979 is a single partial specimen from the Djadokhta Formation at Ukhaa Tolgod; the 75–71 Ma route is a formation-level sample window, not a direct date for every element or a global oviraptorosaurian FAD/LAD.

The folded limbs over at least fifteen eggs and the lack of evident transport support a brooding or parental-care interpretation, but they do not directly observe behaviour or establish a single, complete nesting system.

The route opens generic taxon/period map context; it has no study-locality or specimen selector. Read the linked evidence dossier for the cited material. Available markers are separate occurrence records and do not locate or guarantee those study samples.

title.zh: 埃德蒙顿龙地狱溪组皮肤埋藏学窗口

description.en: Use the 67–66 Ma interval as generic taxon/age map context and read the linked study of NDGS 2000, a skin-bearing Edmontosaurus specimen from North Dakota’s Hell Creek Formation, with CT, sediment and feeding-trace evidence for its preservation.
description.zh: 以 67–66 Ma 区间作为一般类群/时间地图背景，阅读关联研究中的 NDGS 2000：来自北达科他州地狱溪组的带皮肤埃德蒙顿龙标本，以及关于其保存过程的 CT、沉积物与取食痕迹证据。

limitations: NDGS 2000 is one carcass from the Hell Creek Formation in North Dakota; 67–66 Ma follows the sampled latest-Cretaceous cranial and mummy envelope, not a direct date for every tissue or a global Edmontosaurus FAD/LAD.

Skin draped over bones, punctures, hook scores and CT-visible manus anatomy are observations. Scavenging-assisted deflation, desiccation and burial are a proposed taphonomic pathway for this carcass, not a universal preservation recipe or evidence of original colour or physiology.

The route opens generic taxon/period map context; it has no study-locality or specimen selector. Read the linked evidence dossier for the cited material. Available markers are separate occurrence records and do not locate or guarantee those study samples.

title.en: Tyrannosaurus western North American osteophagy window
title.zh: 霸王龙北美西部食骨证据窗口

description.en: Use the 68–66 Ma latest-Maastrichtian interval as generic map context and read the linked osteophagy evidence. MOR 799 bite traces are from Montana’s Hell Creek Formation; coprolite SMNH P2609.1 is from Saskatchewan’s Frenchman Formation. The adult skull sample supplies a separate model of Tyrannosaurus bone-fracturing capability.
description.zh: 以 68–66 Ma 最晚马斯特里赫特期区间作为一般地图背景，阅读关联的食骨证据。MOR 799 咬痕来自蒙大拿州地狱溪组，粪化石 SMNH P2609.1 来自萨斯喀彻温省 Frenchman 组；成年头骨样本另行提供霸王龙碎骨能力的模型。

limitations: Approximately eighty tooth traces on the Triceratops ilium MOR 799 and bone in coprolite SMNH P2609.1 document bone interaction and ingestion in bounded contexts; the 68–66 Ma route is a latest-Maastrichtian sample window, not a global FAD/LAD.

Bite force and tooth-pressure values are muscle-and-lever model outputs from BHI 3033 and six comparative adult skulls. They test capability rather than directly observing a feeding event or proving that every Tyrannosaurus used the same strategy.

The route opens generic taxon/period map context; it has no study-locality or specimen selector. Read the linked evidence dossier for the cited material. Available markers are separate occurrence records and do not locate or guarantee those study samples.
